chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, entered upon Khadijah while she was in the condition that had come upon her, and he said to her.
"Despite what we see of your condition, O Khadijah, when you come to your co-wives, then convey my salam (greeting of peace) to them."
She said, "Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?"
He said, "Maryam daughter of 'Imran, and Kulthum the sister of Musa, and Asiyah the wife of Fir'awn."
She said, "With well-being, O Messenger of Allah."

key_terms.السَّلَامَ: greeting of peace to be conveyed
key_terms.بِالرِّفَاءِ: an expression of well-being and gracious response
key_terms.خَدِيجَةَ: Khadijah, the wife of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.ضَرَائِرِكِ: your co-wives; here referring to women who will be joined with her in the Hereafter
key_terms.فِرْعَوْنَ: Pharaoh, the tyrant ruler mentioned in sacred history
key_terms.كُلْثُمُ: Kulthum, identified here as the sister of Musa

ai.seo_question: Which women did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم mention to Khadijah at the time of her final illness?
ai.summary: This report narrates the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم visiting Khadijah in her final illness and instructing her to convey his salam to noble women of faith in the Hereafter. It highlights Khadijah’s rank and connects her with Maryam, the sister of Musa, and Asiyah, the wife of Fir'awn.
